title: centaurea scabiosa var. ossethica
intro: Centaurea scabiosa var. ossethica, commonly known as Ossetian scabiosa, is a plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine to promote digestive health and alleviate symptoms of gastrointestinal disorders, such as constipation and irritable bowel syndrome, due to its potential health benefits. The plant's therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may contribute to its medicinal effects. The bioactive constituents of Centaurea scabiosa var. ossethica include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions and potential health benefits.
